reply_lines: When I read your sentence, I pay extra attention to the important words.
That is literally called 'attention' in AI — cool name, right?
Some words matter more than others in a sentence.
Let us plan which words matter most: 'quick' or 'easy' in 'quick easy dinner'?
Yes! 'Quick' is the key word — it tells me you want something fast.
I weigh each word to figure out what matters most.
Big helpers can look at all the words in a sentence at the same time.
That is much better than reading one word at a time!
Hi! I am Claude. Attention is one of my superpowers!
Ask me about 'word' or 'sentence' to learn how I use it.
